stem:
The diagram shows a model of the moon, Earth, and the sun forming a right angle.

Based on the position of the moon in the diagram, which of these is occurring in the ocean?

options.label: A
options.text: A neap tide, which results in the smallest difference between the high and low tide

options.label: B
options.text: A spring tide, which results in the greatest difference between the high and low tide

options.label: C
options.text: A neap tide, which results in the greatest difference between the high and low tide

options.label: D
options.text: A spring tide, which results in the smallest difference between the high and low tide
